facts.text: The Brenau Promise covers full tuition and development fees for eligible recipients of HOPE and Pell grants after other aid is applied.

sources.title: The Brenau Promise for HOPE and Pell Recipients
sources.quote: The Brenau Promise for HOPE and Pell Recipients ensures that an eligible student's full tuition and Institutional & Instructional (I&I) development fee are covered after all applicable institutional, state and federal scholarships and grants have been awarded.
